messages:
neha: Urgent: Acme Health POC streaming failing. Browser shows JSON.parse errors and EventSource reconnects. Demo in ~24h.
anna: Client paste from console: `Error: Unexpected end of JSON input`. They captured SSE payload and it's cut mid-record.
sam: Which client lib? EventSource (native) or polyfill?
anna: React app using EventSource polyfill.
dmitri: Two top causes: server is flushing a large JSON across multiple TCP writes (so client sees partial object) OR an intermediate proxy/LB is closing idle SSE connections (common 30s timeout). Any proxy logs?
anna: Proxy excerpt:
`[2026-04-02T09:10:21Z] GET /v1/stream/patient-summary 200 chunked`
`[2026-04-02T09:10:49Z] upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream`
anna: App stdout shows flush traces then `Error: write EPIPE`.
dmitri: EPIPE -> remote closed first (client/proxy). Quick mitigation: 1) change server to emit each SSE event as a complete JSON object (avoid mid-object flush), 2) send heartbeat comments every 10-15s to keep proxies alive, 3) client-side buffer/parse only on full object delimiter.
sam: For the demo, we can push a canary enabling full-event flush + 12s heartbeat. Also give the client a tiny client-side pattern to avoid parse errors: buffer incoming event.data until you detect `\n\n` or a complete JSON parse succeeds.
anna: Deploying canary now.
deploy-bot: canary: deployed rev d4e1 -> sse_heartbeat_seconds=12, sse_full_event_flush=true (09:32)
anna: Client tested canary for 45m: "no parse errors, stream stayed open"
neha: That unblocks the demo. Security still needs audit/KMS answers but that's separate.
dmitri: Follow-ups: run 24h canary soak, add platform metric for SSE reconnection rate and alert if >5% in 5m, and create short SSE customer guidance (heartbeat, per-event JSON, client buffering).
neha: Thanks team, marking POC as ready for demo. :tada:
